title: 新增数据规模页
title_en: New Data Scale Page
changes: 新增**数据规模**页面（页脚「数据」栏入口）：一页看全本站到底攒了多少数据
社团侧：成员数、比赛记录、逐月走势柱状图、赛事类型分布、成员标签与荣誉
职业赛事历史库：6.7 万条记录、6000+ 名球员、2001 年至今的五个单项分布
内容与素材：文章条目、改稿留档、媒体附件与素材库体积构成
页面支持中英切换与明暗主题自适应
changes_en: Added a **Data Scale** page (linked from the footer's Data column) showing at a glance how much data this site holds
Club side: member count, match records, a matches-by-month chart, match type breakdown, member tags and honours
Professional tournament archive: 67k+ records, 6000+ players, and the five event breakdowns since 2001
Content and media: article count, archived revisions, media attachments and the media library's size breakdown
The page supports language switching and follows the light/dark theme

title: 比赛详情页、双打榜单与全站英文化
title_en: Match Details, Doubles Rankings and Full English Support
changes: 新增**比赛详情**页面：记分牌、逐局比分、积分明细、胜率预测与历史交锋
新增**双打**积分榜：排名页可切换「单打 / 双打」，组合按独立主体计分（赛事系数 0.5、不衰减）
排名页**移动端**重做为卡片式排行榜，支持拼音搜索与点列头排序
全站英文适配完成：切到英文后 31 个界面无中文残留，球员显示拼音名
新增**网站文档**页面（导航栏 More… 入口）；首页彩蛋球改为直达 3D 乒乓球；赛季总结新增按日积分走势图
changes_en: Added a new **Match Detail** page: scoreboard, game-by-game scores, points breakdown, win-rate prediction and head-to-head history
Added a **Doubles** leaderboard: the Ranking page switches between Singles and Doubles, with each pair scored as an independent entity (coefficient 0.5, no decay)
Rebuilt the **mobile** Ranking page as a card-based leaderboard with pinyin search and tap-to-sort headers
Finished the full English pass: after switching, all 31 interfaces show no Chinese and players show pinyin names
Added a **Docs** page (under More… in the navbar); the home page easter-egg ball now links straight to the 3D game; the Season Review page gained a daily points trend chart

title: 赛季总结页
title_en: Season Review Page
changes: 新增**赛季总结**页面（数据可视化页底部入口）
WTT 彩蛋同步上线**赛季总结**，入口在 WTT Hub 类目卡片
changes_en: Added a new **Season Review** page (linked from the bottom of the Data Viz page)
The WTT easter egg also got a **Season Review** page, with its entry point on the category card in WTT Hub

title: 访客提交战绩功能上线
title_en: Visitor Match Submission Goes Live
changes: 新增**提交战绩**页面，访客可在线填写比赛记录（日期、类型、赛制、胜者、负者、比分），管理员审核后计入排名
排名页「积分计算规则」下方新增「提交战绩」入口按钮
界面细节优化：精简首页骨干版块文案，清理废弃的个人页导出代码
changes_en: Added a new **Submit Results** page where visitors can fill in match records online (date, event type, format, winner, loser, score); once an administrator has reviewed them they count towards the ranking
Added a "Submit Results" entry button under "Scoring Rules" on the Ranking page
UI polish: trimmed the copy in the core-members block on the home page and removed the dead export code from the personal page

title: 主页面样式优化
title_en: Home Page Styling Improvements
changes: 优化了移动端在wtt积分数据表和wtt个人数据的计算速度
优化了主页面的hero部分样式
优化了competitions页面的**对阵表**(drawers)的显示
增加大量ittf在2002-2005, 2013-2015年的公开赛，世界杯，世乒赛的比赛数据
本次更新后，wtt彩蛋的比赛数据总数达到了：**51,425**条
changes_en: Improved the computation speed of the WTT points table and the WTT personal data on mobile
Restyled the hero section of the home page
Improved the display of the **draws** (brackets) on the Competitions page
Added a large amount of ITTF match data for the open, World Cup and World Championships events of 2002-2005 and 2013-2015
After this update, the WTT easter egg's match-data total reached **51,425** records

title: 移动端适配优化
title_en: Mobile Adaptation Improvements
changes: 优化了移动端在积分数据表和数据可视化的表现
增加了数据加载的进度条
changes_en: Improved how the points table and the data visualisation behave on mobile
Added a progress bar for data loading

title: WTT 协会籍：修复排名旗帜显示并新增协会数据可视化
title_en: WTT Associations: fixed flag display in the ranking and added association data visualisation
changes: 在 WTT 单打积分数据表姓名左侧增加了协会旗帜的显示
WTT 数据可视化新增 **协会积分趋势** 折线图：可勾选协会 + 最近 N 个数据点，展示协会实力分随时间变化
WTT 数据可视化新增 **协会前五球员** 柱状图：按实时快照协会实力分降序展示各协会前五球员积分
定义协会实力分公式：0.4×第1 + 0.3×第2 + 0.15×第3 + 0.1×第4 + 0.05×第5（不足 5 人按已用权重归一化）
本次更新后，wtt彩蛋的比赛数据总数达到了：**21,086**条
changes_en: Added association flags to the left of player names in the WTT singles points table
The WTT data visualisation gained a new **Association Points Trend** line chart: pick associations and the most recent N data points to see how association strength scores change over time

The WTT data visualisation gained a new **Top Five Players per Association** bar chart, showing the points of each association's top five players ordered by association strength score in the latest snapshot
Defined the association strength score: 0.4x1st + 0.3x2nd + 0.15x3rd + 0.1x4th + 0.05x5th (normalised by the weights used when fewer than 5 players are available)
After this update, the WTT easter egg's match-data total reached **21,086** records

title: 数据可视化页面:更新多种图表
title_en: Data Viz Page: A Batch of New Charts
changes: 同步在数据可视化页面和wtt数据可视化页面加上了多种新图表
changes_en: Added a range of new charts to both the data visualisation page and the WTT data visualisation page

title: 数据更新：增加了2026wtt支线赛、亚洲杯、欧冠等等的比赛数据
title_en: Data update: added 2026 WTT feeder events, the Asian Cup, the Champions League and more
changes: 本次更新后，wtt彩蛋的比赛数据总数达到了：**20,638**条
changes_en: After this update, the WTT easter egg's match-data total reached **20,638** records

title: 优化搜索功能，个人数据页
title_en: Improved search and the personal data page
changes: 个人数据页改为总览模式：标签筛选 + 姓名/编号/标签搜索 + 球员卡片列表，点击进入对应个人主页
排名页、全站搜索、数据可视化、社团骨干页的球员姓名均链接到个人主页
changes_en: The personal data page is now an overview mode: tag filters, name/number/tag search, and a list of player cards — click one to open that player's page
Player names on the Ranking page, in site-wide search, in data visualisation and on the core members page now all link to the player's personal page

title: WTT 彩蛋页面支持中英文双语
title_en: WTT Easter-Egg Pages Are Now Bilingual
changes: WTT Hub、WTT 排名、WTT 数据可视化、WTT 个人数据页面新增中英文语言切换
WTT 页面的图表标签、加载进度、对比/个人统计等动态内容随语言实时刷新
changes_en: WTT Hub, WTT Ranking, WTT Data Viz and the WTT personal data page gained a Chinese/English language switch
Chart labels, loading progress and comparison/personal statistics on the WTT pages now refresh live when the language changes

title: 微调了积分系统规则
title_en: Fine-tuned the points system rules
changes: 微调了积分系统规则，详细规则见 ***https://yglalpavir.github.io/wfls-tt-club/detail.html?type=qa&id=q1***
改动较小，没有造成排名的变化
changes_en: Fine-tuned the points system rules — the full rules are at ***https://yglalpavir.github.io/wfls-tt-club/detail.html?type=qa&id=q1***
The change was small and did not shift the rankings

title: 数据更新：增加了2025年WTT双打、2018-2024的T联赛、2026全锦赛男双的全部比赛记录
title_en: Data update: added all 2025 WTT doubles, 2018-2024 T-League and 2026 National Championships men's doubles match records
changes: 本次更新后，wtt彩蛋的比赛数据总数达到了：**17,999**条
changes_en: After this update, the WTT easter egg's match-data total reached **17,999** records

title: 数据更新：增加了2026年WTT的男双，女双，混双的全部比赛记录
title_en: Data update: added all 2026 WTT men's doubles, women's doubles and mixed doubles match records
changes: 本次更新后，wtt彩蛋的比赛数据总数达到了：**14,451**条
changes_en: After this update, the WTT easter egg's match-data total reached **14,451** records

title: 数据更新：增加了部分女单、男双的比赛记录
title_en: Data update: added some women's singles and men's doubles match records
changes: 本次更新后，wtt彩蛋的比赛数据总数达到了：**12,893**条
changes_en: After this update, the WTT easter egg's match-data total reached **12,893** records

title: 数据更新：增加了德甲、全运会的比赛记录
title_en: Data update: added Bundesliga and National Games match records
changes: 数据更新：增加了德甲2025/2026赛季的全部比赛记录；增加了全运会的比赛记录
修改彩蛋进入后的页面，为之后可能的女子单打/男子双打/女子双打/混合双打更新留下入口
本次更新后，wtt（指彩蛋，其中的数据包含且不限定于是WTT）的比赛数据总数达到了：**8,296**条
changes_en: Data update: added all match records from the 2025/2026 Bundesliga season, plus the National Games match records
Changed the page you land on after opening the easter egg, leaving room for possible future women's singles / men's doubles / women's doubles / mixed doubles updates
After this update, the WTT easter egg's match-data total (its data includes, but is not limited to, WTT) reached **8,296** records

title: 数据更新：2021和2022年的wtt男子单打比赛数据
title_en: Data update: 2021 and 2022 WTT men's singles match data
changes: 更新了2021和2022年的wtt比赛数据，目前比赛数据覆盖了wtt创立以来的全部比赛记录，总数据数达到了**7,795**条
changes_en: Updated the 2021 and 2022 WTT match data; the data now covers every match since WTT was founded, bringing the total to **7,795** records

title: Member页优化
title_en: Members Page Improvements
changes: 增加了对显示“核心成员”的**qq头像**的支持
changes_en: Added support for showing **QQ avatars** for the "core members"

title: Draws样式优化和wtt积分模型优化
title_en: Draws Styling and the WTT Points Model
changes: 在Competitions页增加了对draws的优化，包括：优化页面尺寸，优化网格吸附，优化卡片和晋级线样式等
wtt积分模型优化：调低了各个比赛的比赛系数，避免了积分和名次因一场比赛大幅度波动
changes_en: Improved the draws on the Competitions page: page sizing, grid snapping, and the styling of cards and progression lines
WTT points model: lowered the event coefficients so that points and rankings no longer swing wildly on the back of a single match

title: Competitions页面的draws支持
title_en: Draws Support on the Competitions Page
changes: 在Competitions页增加了对draws的支持，用户可以查看比赛的签表信息
changes_en: Added draws support to the Competitions page, so users can view the bracket for each event

title: 个人积分趋势图更新，同步新增wtt个人数据页
title_en: Personal Points Trend Chart Updated, Plus a New WTT Personal Data Page
changes: 个人数据页面新增**积分变化趋势折线图**，支持按天/按周/快照三种粒度切换查看
个人数据页面新增**最高积分**和**最高排名**统计概览指标
新增了wtt个人数据页面，与个人数据页面对应，展示选手在wtt比赛中的积分变化趋势、最高积分和最高排名
多项表格与组件字体大小微调，响应式布局优化
changes_en: The personal data page gained a new **points trend line chart**, switchable between daily, weekly and snapshot granularity
The personal data page gained **peak points** and **peak ranking** summary stats
Added a WTT personal data page mirroring the personal data page, showing each player's points trend, peak points and peak ranking across WTT matches
Fine-tuned font sizes across several tables and components, and improved the responsive layout

title: 个人数据独立页面、选手标签系统与荣誉成就展示
title_en: Standalone Personal Data Page, Player Tag System and Honours Display
changes: 新增**个人数据**独立页面（personal_stats.html），从数据可视化页面中分离出个人数据模块
新增**荣誉成就展示**，在个人数据页面展示球员的获奖记录（如校乒赛单打冠军、团体冠军等）
新增 `data/player-tags.json` 数据文件，管理选手标签与荣誉信息
changes_en: Added a standalone **Personal Data** page (personal_stats.html), splitting the personal data module out of the data visualisation page
Added an **honours display** showing each player's titles and awards (such as School Championship singles and team champions) on the personal data page
Added the `data/player-tags.json` data file to manage player tags and honours

title: 新增更新wtt数据可视化
title_en: New and Updated WTT Data Visualisation
changes: 新增更新wtt数据可视化（wtt_dataviz）页面，功能与样式同校数据可视化（data_viz）页面
新增了2023年的wtt比赛数据
changes_en: Added the new WTT data visualisation (wtt_dataviz) page, with the same features and styling as the club data visualisation (data_viz) page
Added 2023 WTT match data

title: 新增更新日志页面
title_en: New Changelog Page
changes: 新增**更新日志（Changelog）**页面，记录网站版本更新历史
在数据可视化（Data Viz Beta）页面，仿照开球网，增加了个人数据分析模块
changes_en: Added a **Changelog** page recording the site's version history
Added a personal data analysis module to the Data Viz Beta page, in the style of the Kaiqiuwang table tennis portal

title: 数据可视化优化、新闻标签扩展与筛选功能新增
title_en: Data Visualisation Improvements, a New News Tag and Tag Filtering
changes: 修改数据可视化（Data Viz Beta）页面中的积分趋势和排名变化河流图，使之使用实时积分的数据作为最近的一个数据（最后的一个数据）
给新闻标签tag类型增加“日常”用于发布一般的消息，设计合适的颜色来适配日间/夜间模式
在news页和competitions页增加按标签筛选要查看的条目的功能
changes_en: Changed the points trend and rank change stream graphs on the Data Viz Beta page so that they use live points as the most recent (i.e. final) data point
Added a "Daily" news tag for general notices, with colours chosen to work in both light and dark modes
Added tag filtering of the entries shown on the News and Competitions pages

title: 社团官网正式上线发布
title_en: The Club Website Goes Live
changes: **武汉外国语学校乒乓球社团官方网站正式对外发布**
首页：展示社团基本信息、历史、理念、活动及核心成员
近期动态（News）页面：发布社团最新通知与日常动态
赛事信息（Competitions）页面：展示比赛安排与结果
积分排名（Ranking Beta）页面：基于 Elo 机制的积分排名系统
联系我们（Contact）页面：社团QQ群二维码与联系方式
社团骨干（Core Members）页面：展示社团管理层信息
数据可视化（Data Viz Beta）页面：积分趋势图与排名变化图
常见问题（Q&A）页面：解答社团相关常见问题
支持中英文双语切换
支持日间/夜间模式切换
支持全站搜索功能
响应式设计，适配桌面端与移动端
changes_en: **The official website of the WFLS Table Tennis Club is now live**
Home page: club basics, history, philosophy, activities and core members
News page: the club's latest notices and daily updates
Competitions page: match schedules and results
Ranking Beta page: an Elo-based points and ranking system
Contact page: the club QQ group QR code and contact details
Core Members page: the club's management team
Data Viz Beta page: points trend and rank change charts
Q&A page: answers to common questions about the club
Chinese/English language switching
Light/dark mode switching
Site-wide search
Responsive design for desktop and mobile
